market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by widespread volume exhaustion and tight range-bound compression across all monitored assets. US100 remains trapped between GEX Put Wall #1 resistance and VWAP/Put Wall #2 support. Strict capital preservation warrants a universal HOLD posture across all symbols.
